title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: National full-service payments system established that is efficient and affordable by poor individual

No. of payments terminals increases by 10% per annum Achievement: 95,675 Progress/Status: • Total number of payments terminals has reached 95,675 by the end of Q4 2021 (latest available statistics). Number of payments terminals increased by 19% annually in 2021 which has been exceeded more than 4 times than 2023 target number of 17,500. • The project is continually supporting the improvements payments infrastructure at NETC and BOM. The banks and Fintech companies are increasing investment in payments terminals rapidly. Data Source: BOM database Actual value: 95,675

Business continuity plan is in place Progress/Status: • The project successfully completed provision of core network security devices and security network upgrade to NETC in 2017. • The project successfully completed extension of NETC inter-bank core network in 2017. • NETC Remote Data Center's renovation was completed by BOM in 2019. • NETC's Main Data Center renovation was commenced in Sep 2019 and completed in 2020. • BOM and NETC business continuity planning and its relevant directives are already in place. • BOM and NETC IT teams do periodic business continuity testing at the data centers as required by business continuity planning and its relevant directives Data Source: BOM database Base year: 2012 Baseline value: N

Interbank payment transactions increase by 15% per annum Achievement: 100,438,026 Progress/Status: - Interbank low value (ACH) transactions are stood at 98,150,450 annually and high value (RTGS) transactions are stood at 2,287,576. Total interbank payments are stood around 100,438,026 million as of the end of Q4 2021. - NETC unofficial data in 2020 and 2021 show 50% annual increase of interbank payment transactions which are 3 times higher increase than the expected result of 15% annual increase.
- The new upgraded RTGS Second generation system was launched in January 2018. The contract is successfully closed. - The new ACH+ system was launched on 15 August 2019. The contract is successfully closed. - Implementation of a new CSD system for securities market has been started in early 2020. MCSD dataset migration on production environment was done on 25 August 2022. After completion of SIT (System Integration testing) and UAT (User acceptance testing) tests, Market rehearsal activities were started on 19 Sep 2022 and completed in November 2022. The 2nd round of MR activity was completed on 19 December 2022 and system was accepted by the Bank of Mongolia. Achieved. Interbank payment transactions volume as published in BOM Annual Report 2021 reached 132,610,900, which is 1700%-time increase from the baseline. Data Source: BOM database Baseline value: 7,137,800

New forms of payment services, including interoperable mobile payments, are introduced Progress/Status: • The new ACH+ system was launched on 15 August 2019. As launching the ACH system, NETC had started to support new forms of payments such as direct debit, batch payments and CAMs (central addressing module) which are effectively used in interbank low value payments. • T card EMV/NFC technology specification has been defined. A new security proven EMV/NFC chip based T cards issued by banks. • NETC card switching system was launched in April 2021. As launching the system, NETC has acquired the capabilities to support new forms of card payments such as card payments , pre-authorization and card depositing transactions etc. • Card Tokenization system. The contract between the BOM and the Consortium of Tridum e-Security & HPS was signed on 8 November 2021. TSP system has launched successfully on 23 November 2022 by the contractor and NETC. Data Source: BOM database Base year: 2012 Baseline value: N

Protection mechanisms, such as use of IC-based chips, firewalls, anti-key logging, and authentication processes and procedures, established Progress/Status: • The project successfully completed provision of core network security devices and security network upgrade to NETC in 2017. • The project successfully completed extension of NETC inter-bank core network in 2017. • Public Key Infrastructure implementation has been completed in NETC infrastructure in 2018. PKI infrastructure to support financial organizations are ready. • For improvement of national T card security, BOM and MasterCard has signed technology partnership agreement in Nov 2019 to jointly work together on T card EMV/NFC migration.
• To support usage of a new and more secure EMV/NFC based T cards, BOM has signed the contract with the Ubvelox Inc of Koreas to manufacture EMV/NFC T-Cards to increase of issuance by Mongolian commercial banks. BOM has helped Mongolian banks to issue over 1 million EMV contact & contactless ₮-Cards in 2021-2022.
• Security Operation Center (SOC). The new Security Operation Center for NETC was launched in 2021. NETC and BOM are monitoring all fraudulent activities and unauthorized accesses in NETC main network and payments systems. • Card Tokenization system. The contract between the BOM and the Consortium of Tridum e-Security & HPS was signed on 8 November 2021. The contract implementation is ongoing Data Source: BOM database Base year: 2012 Baseline value: N

Required laws and regulations are passed Progress/Status: Progress/Status of relevant projects: • The new payment system law has been approved by parliament in 2017. • The low value interbank payment regulation was replaced by the new regulation on ACH rules and it come in force since launch of ACH+ system in 15 August 2019. • The regulation on payments services license is approved by BOM in 2018. • The new mobile payments regulation is approved by BOM in 2019. • The new card payments regulation is approved by BOM in 2019. • The guidance on RTGS and ACH payments participants was renewed and approved by BOM in 2021. Data Source: BOM database Base year: 2012 Baseline value: N
Standardization is in place Progress/Status: No substantive updates at this stage. Data Source: BOM database Base year: 2012 Baseline value: N

Volume of payment card transactions increase by 15% per annum Achievement: 303,706,593 Progress/Status: - NETC unofficial data in 2020 and 2021 show 20% annual increase of payment card transactions which are higher increase than the expected result of 15% annual increase.
- The new upgraded RTGS Second generation system was launched in January 2018. The relevant contract has been successfully closed. - - Achieved. Annual volume of payment card transactions in 2021 rose to 576.9 million, which is being 878% increase from 2012 baseline.
- The new ACH+ system was launched on 15 August 2019. The relevant contract has been successfully closed. - BOM and MasterCard has signed technology partnership agreement in Nov 2019 to jointly work together on T card EMV/NFC migration.
- BOM has signed the contract with the Ubivelox LL of Korea for supplying T card based on EMV/NFC technology on 27 Aug 2020. The contractor had shipped all 1 million cards to BOM by 2nd quarter of 2022. BOM has helped Mongolian banks to issue over 1 million EMV contact & contactless ₮-Cards in 2021-2022. The project is completed
- NETC card switching system was launched in April 2021. The contract is successfully closed. - Implementation of a new CSD system for securities market has been started in early 2020. The System Integration testing and User acceptance testing tests, Market rehearsal activities were started on 19 Sep 2022 and completed on 19 December 2022 and system was accepted by the Bank of Mongolia.
- Card Tokenization system. The contract between the BOM and the Consortium of Tridum e-Security & HPS was signed on 8 November 2021. All hardware equipment and databases were set up by the manufacturer HPS and installation of the system in the Production environment completed on 23 October 2022. The test cases and user acceptance test plan was finalized and shared with all parties on 10 October 2022. Disaster recovery test including HA, Failover, DR availability and business continuity tests were performed on the hardware equipment at the Bank of Mongolia premises and completed on the 15 November, 2022. TSP system has launched successfully on 23 November 2022 by the contractor and NETC. Data Source: BOM database Baseline value: 59,400,000
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Interbank payment systems infrastructure strengthened Indicator: All infrastructure components specified under the ADB loan are procured and installed and become operational Progress/Status: • The new upgraded RTGS Second generation system was launched in January 2018.
• BOM has been implementing its Core Banking System since June 2019 with contractor, Intellect Design Arena Limited, India. The final stage of system testing and operational acceptance testing was completed on 23 December 2022.
• BOM has started implementation of Mongolian Unified CSD system with contractor, CMA Small Systems AB (Sweden). Phase 5 “Software Installation and Commissioning” was completed and test specification document is approved by the BoM. After completion of SIT (System Integration testing) and UAT (User acceptance testing) tests, Market rehearsal (MR) activities were started on 19 Sep 2022 and completed in November 2022. The 2nd round of MR activity was completed on 19 December 2022 and system was accepted by the Bank of Mongolia for its part of operations on the same day.
• The contracts for Supply and Installation of Security Operation Center at NETC system were awarded in December 2020. Lot 1: The Security Operation Center System implementation is completed on 29 November 2021, and NETC launched the SOC system in a production environment. Lot 2: Software subscription license of network equipment: all software licenses provided by the contractor were accepted by the BOM on 14 May 2021. Lot 3: Hardware and software for Fin Tech lab: all hardware and software supplied by the Contractor is accepted by the BOM on 14 May 2021.
The contract BOM Big Data package was awarded on 6 Dec 2021. The equipment was delivered to BOM on 12 Jan 2022. The contract is completed Data Source: Documentation by the NETC Actual value:

Output: Legal and regulatory framework established Indicator: Laws and regulations required to underpin the operation of the modernized payments system are passed Achievement: 5 Progress/Status: • The new payment system law has been approved by parliament in 2017. • The high value interbank payment regulation (RTGS) has been renewed. The new regulation come in force with the launch of 2nd generation RTGS system in 2018. • The low value interbank payment regulation has been replaced by the new ACH rules and regulations and come in force with the launch of ACH+ system in 15 August 2019. • The new card payments regulation has been approved by BOM in 2019. • Payments services license regulation has been approved by BOM in 2018. • The new mobile payments regulation has been approved by BOM in 2019. • RTGS payments and ACH payments guidance for participants have been renewed and approved by BOM in 2021. • BOM and NETC have approved interbank QR code payments standards in Q1 of 2022.
Data Source: BOM regulations and directives and legislative acts

Output: The retail payment systems infrastructure and support systems upgraded Indicator: All infrastructure components specified under the ADB loan are procured and installed and become operational Achievement: 3 Progress/Status: - Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) implementation has been completed in NETC infrastructure in 2018. - NETC Fiber Network Extension - successfully completed in Q4 2017 and became operational. - The new ACH+ system was launched on 15 August 2019. The relevant contract has been successfully closed. - NETC card management bidding has been announced in March 2020 a through direct contracting. BOM has awarded a contract to Compass Plus company of UK in July 2020. The vendor has conducted a technical and functional training to NETC staffs and provided HWs. NETC Card management system launched in April 2021. The final payment was made to the contractor on 5 Jan 2022. The contract activities completed. - The contract for supply of national T card systems was awarded to Ubivelox LLC of Korea. The vendor has supplied a 1,000,000 cards to BOM by Mar 2022. The BOM helped to issue 1 million EMV contact & contactless ₮-Cards in 2021-2022. - The contract for supply and installation of IT equipment and device for National Electronic Transactions Center (NETC) was awarded on 29 June 2020. The vendor completed supply and installations of devices. The contract is completed. - The procurement package for implementation of Mobile NFC enablement (either HCE or TSM) and Tokenization Service was re-advertised several times, in May, September 2020 and in February 2021. The contract between the BOM and the Consortium of Tridum e-Security & HPS was signed on 8 November 2021. TSP system has launched successfully on 23 November 2022 by the contractor and NETC. Data Source: Documentation by the BOM
